280-1479-8338.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-3196-6867.description:
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ by paying its mana cost, returning Appa from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the _____ attached to it.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Last Voyage of the _____.
Last Voyage of the _____ triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Appa, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Last Voyage of the _____ ability, doing nothing.
Cast Last Voyage of the _____ from exile by paying {2}, returning Appa from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the _____ attached to it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5131-5330-8176--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5330-8176--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

3756-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

1580-4871-5075-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3188-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2292-6553-7424.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1806-2060-6774-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

413-891-1052.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

198-3767-3918-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Trazyn and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
198-3767-3918-7223.notes: If Trazyn has a charge counter on it, the starting cost is {0}

147-4050-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-3301-4002.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

4251-4359-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
4251-4359-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2034-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

628-5256-6487.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, and repeat from step 1.

1550-1879-2105.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-1879-2105.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

390-2713-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Hulking Metamorph has a power of at least 2.
390-2713-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Hulking Metamorph and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Hulking Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Hulking Metamorph to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Hulking Metamorph enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

728-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-5470.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

549-1365-2511-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-2511-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

703-2506-2557.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Parallel Lives that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Parallel Lives tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

224-1361-1737-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
224-1361-1737-4832.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ancient Den.
When the Ancient Den token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

2713-3099-3767-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
2713-3099-3767-4289.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1733-2724-3217.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Nephalia Smuggler. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

229-2018-4053.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
229-2018-4053.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

2876-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Nim Deathmantle attached to Elenda.
Elenda has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2876-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {1}.
Elenda dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing three Vampire tokens, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying {4} to return Elenda to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {1}.
Elenda triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {1}.
Elenda dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Vampire tokens, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 5.

864-2103-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Eternal Witness.
864-2103-2665.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the token Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
